title: DELETE /api/projects/:id/journal/:jid — soft delete journal entry
description: Soft delete a journal entry by setting deleted_at.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE requires auth and project ownership
Entry no longer appears in journal list

steps.details: getOwnedProject. Find entry WHERE id = jid AND project_id = id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Set deleted_at = NOW(). Return 200.
Create entry, delete it, verify it's gone from list. Check DB — deleted_at is set.
